warp.dest-header.title: Door leads nowhere
warp.dest-header.text: The door leads to Header {1:id}, which does not exist (the project has {2} headers). Choose a destination or delete the door.

building.text: The door leads to Place {1:id}, which does not exist (the project has {2} places). Choose a destination or delete the door.

warp.dest-warp.title: Target warp missing
warp.dest-warp.text: The door leads to Warp {2} in Header {1:id}, but its event file {3:id} has only {4} warps. Choose another target warp or add one there.

building.text: The door leads to Warp {2} of Place {1:id}, but its event file {3:id} has only {4} warps. Choose another target warp or add one there.

warp.off-map.title: Door outside the map
warp.off-map.text: The door is at x {1}, z {2}, outside the maps of Header {3:id}. Move it onto a map or delete it.

building.text: The door is at x {1}, z {2}, outside the maps of Place {3:id}. Move it onto a map or delete it.

warp.never-fires.title: Door never triggers
warp.never-fires.text: The door at x {1}, z {2} is not on a door or stairs tile, and no warp leads to it. Put it on a door tile or hide the hint.

event.trainer-missing.title: Trainer missing
event.trainer-missing.text: Script {1} starts a battle against Trainer {2}, who does not exist (the project has {3} trainers). Choose a trainer or another script.

event.off-map.title: Event outside the map
event.off-map.text: The event is at x {2}, z {3}, outside the maps of Header {4:id}. Move it onto a map or delete it.

building.text: The event is at x {2}, z {3}, outside the maps of Place {4:id}. Move it onto a map or delete it.

event.trainer-blind.title: Trainer cannot see
event.trainer-blind.text: The character fights as Trainer {2} but has trainer type 0: it never spots the player and only fights when spoken to. Set the trainer type or hide the warning.

event.trigger-empty.title: Trigger without script
event.trigger-empty.text: The trigger at x {1}, z {2} has Script 0 and does nothing. Choose a script or delete the trigger.

event.same-spot.title: Two characters on one tile
event.same-spot.text: Object {1} is at x {2}, z {3}, the same spot as Object {0}, and neither has a hide flag. Move one character or give one a flag.

header.ref-range.title: Header points nowhere
header.ref-range.text: Header {0:id} gives {2} as its {1:field}, but there are only {3}. Choose a valid value in the header.

building.title: Place points nowhere
building.text: Place {0:id} gives {2} as its {1:field}, but there are only {3}. Choose a valid value for the place.

header.wild-dangling.title: Encounters missing
header.wild-dangling.text: Header {0:id} names encounter file {1:id}, but there are only {2}. Choose an encounter file in the header, or “none”.

building.text: Place {0:id} names encounter file {1:id}, but there are only {2}. Choose an encounter file for the place, or “none”.

header.text-split.title: Script file with several text archives
header.text-split.text: Headers {2} share script file {0:id} but use the text archives {1}; their message numbers fit only one. Give the headers the same text archive or their own script files.

building.text: Places {2} share script file {0:id} but use the text archives {1}; their message numbers fit only one. Give the places the same text archive or their own script files.

matrix.map-range.title: Cell names a missing map
matrix.map-range.text: The cell names Map {3:id}, but there are only {4}. Choose an existing map or clear the cell.

matrix.header-range.title: Cell names a missing header
matrix.header-range.text: The cell names Header {3:id}, but there are only {4}. Choose an existing header.

building.title: Cell names a missing place
building.text: The cell names Place {3:id}, but there are only {4}. Choose an existing place.

matrix.header-elsewhere.title: Header of another matrix
matrix.header-elsewhere.text: The cell names Header {3:id}, which uses Matrix {4}; its events do not appear here. Choose a header of this matrix or change the header’s matrix.

building.title: Area of another world map
building.text: The cell names Area {3:id}, which uses World map {4}; its events do not appear here. Choose an area of this world map or change the area’s world map.

map.model-invalid.title: Map model invalid
map.model-invalid.text: The model of Map {0:id} is invalid ({1}). Import a valid model.

map.bdhc-size.title: Terrain invalid
map.bdhc-size.text: The terrain (BDHC) of Map {0:id} is invalid ({1}). Import a valid terrain.

map.building-range.title: Building without model
map.building-range.text: A building of Map {0:id} uses model {2}, but there are only {3}. Choose an existing model or delete the building.

map.altitude-walkable.title: Height on a walkable cell
map.altitude-walkable.text: Cell {1}, {2} of World map {0:id} is at height {3} and carries Header {4:id}; the game draws the model higher than the ground, so the character walks beneath it. Set the cell’s height to 0.

building.text: Cell {1}, {2} of World map {0:id} is at height {3} and carries Place {4:id}; the game draws the model higher than the ground, so the character walks beneath it. Set the cell’s height to 0.

map.step-unblocked.title: Step without barrier
map.step-unblocked.text: Between tile {1}, {2} and {3}, {4} of Map {0:id} there is a step of {5} units that the game lets the player walk onto. Block the upper cell or place stairs.

map.buildings-over-limit.title: Too many buildings
map.buildings-over-limit.text: Map {0:id} has {1} buildings; the game loads at most {2}, and the rest are missing in the game. Delete buildings or spread them over neighbouring maps.

area.tileset-range.title: Textures missing
area.tileset-range.text: Area data {0:id} gives {2} as its {1:field}, but there are only {3}. Choose an existing texture pack.

place.name-too-long.title: Place name too long
place.name-too-long.text: The place name “{1}” is {2} characters long; the game shows at most 16. Shorten it in the inspector of an area (rename place).

place.index-out-of-bank.title: Place missing from the place name bank
place.index-out-of-bank.text: Header {0:id} points to place name {1}, but the bank has only {2} names. Choose an existing place in the inspector.

building.text: Area {0:id} points to a place that does not exist. Choose an existing place in the inspector.

trainer.no-party.title: Trainer without team
trainer.no-party.text: Trainer {0:id} has no Pokémon: the battle runs against an invisible Pokémon at level 0. Give them a team.

trainer.empty-species.title: Team slot without Pokémon
trainer.empty-species.text: A slot in the team has no Pokémon. Choose a Pokémon or remove the slot.

trainer.id-range.title: Trainer names something unknown
trainer.id-range.text: The {2:field} is {3}, but there are only {4}. Choose an existing value.

trainer.no-moves.title: Pokémon without moves
trainer.no-moves.text: The team has custom moves, but this Pokémon has none and cannot attack. Give it moves or switch off the custom moves.

trainer.double-one.title: Double battle with one Pokémon
trainer.double-one.text: Trainer {0:id} fights a double battle but has only {1} Pokémon. Give them a second Pokémon or choose a single battle.

encounter.empty-slot.title: Empty slot gives a glitch Pokémon
encounter.empty-slot.text: The slot is empty but in use: a glitch Pokémon appears there. Choose a Pokémon for the slot.

encounter.level-zero.title: Pokémon at level 0
encounter.level-zero.text: Species {2:id} appears at level 0. Give the slot a level of 1 or higher.

encounter.level-high.title: Level above 100
encounter.level-high.text: The slot has level {2}, which is more than 100. Choose a level up to 100.

encounter.min-max.title: Minimum level above maximum level
encounter.min-max.text: The minimum level {2} is above the maximum level {3}; the game swaps them. Swap the two yourself or hide the hint.

encounter.rate-byte.title: Rate above 255
encounter.rate-byte.text: The rate {1} is larger than 255, and the game reads only {2}. Choose a rate up to 255.

build.hidden-file.title: Hidden file in the ROM folder
build.hidden-file.text: The hidden file {0} lies under files/ and would end up in the ROM when building; the build stops because of it. “Remove” moves it to .g4/backup.

build.member-gap.title: Gap in the archive folder
build.member-gap.text: In the folder unpacked/{0}, {1} does not fit the sequence 0000, 0001, …; the build stops because of it. Add the missing file or remove the foreign one.

build.unpacked-not-packed.title: Folder is not packed
build.unpacked-not-packed.text: In the folder unpacked/{0}, {1} files have changed, but Studio does not pack it; the change is missing from the built ROM. Repack the archive in DSPRE or revert the change.
build.unpacked-not-packed.one: In the folder unpacked/{0}, 1 file has changed, but Studio does not pack it; the change is missing from the built ROM. Repack the archive in DSPRE or revert the change.

build.base-missing.title: Base ROM unknown
build.base-missing.text: The project does not know its base ROM. “Publish” and “Reset to original” need it. Assign it in Technical under “Publish”.

asset.unreadable.title: File cannot be read
asset.unreadable.text: {asset} cannot be read ({2}). Restore the file; until then Studio checks without it.

event.script-missing.title: Script missing
event.script-missing.text: The event calls Script {2}, but script file {3:id} has scripts only up to {4}. Create the script or choose an existing one.

header.level-target.title: Level script calls a missing script
header.level-target.text: Level script {1:id} starts Script {2}, but script file {3:id} has scripts only up to {4}. Create the script or change the level script.

header.script-kind.title: Wrong script type
header.script-kind.text: Header {0:id} names file {2:id} as its {1:field}, but that file is of the other type. Choose a file of the right type.

building.text: Place {0:id} names file {2:id} as its {1:field}, but that file is of the other type. Choose a file of the right type.

script.message-missing.title: Message missing
script.message-missing.text: The script uses message {2}, but text archive {3:id} has only {4} messages. Create the message or choose an existing one.

script.unreadable.title: Script file cannot be read
script.unreadable.text: Script file {0:id} cannot be read ({1}), and the build would fail because of it. Repair the file or restore it.

text.too-wide.title: Line too wide
text.too-wide.text: The line is {3} px wide, but the text window only {4} px. Wrap it or shorten the text.

text.three-lines.title: Too many lines
text.three-lines.text: Page {2} has {3} lines, but the text window shows only {4}. Split the page with a page break or shorten the text.

text.encode.title: Text cannot be encoded
text.encode.text: The message contains a character the game does not know ({2}); the build stops because of it. Replace the character.

text.json-broken.title: Text archive cannot be read
text.json-broken.text: Text archive {0:id} cannot be read ({1}). Repair the JSON file or restore it.

_words.locked: {{name}} is locked ({{why}}): Gen4 Studio would not write it back byte for byte. Restore the file, then it can be changed.

skipped.ignoreFile: {{file}} is unreadable ({{why}}): nothing is hidden or switched off, and Gen4 Studio does not write the file. Repair or delete it, then both work again.
skipped.notAdopted: {{title}}: not checked, the scripts are not adopted. Adopt them under Script, then Gen4 Studio checks them.
skipped.commonBuilding_one: {{title}}: {{count}} common script without a place not checked.
skipped.commonBuilding_other: {{title}}: {{count}} common scripts without a place not checked.
skipped.commonTech_one: {{title}}: {{count}} common script without a header not checked.
skipped.commonTech_other: {{title}}: {{count}} common scripts without a header not checked.
skipped.oneFile: {{title}}: {{kind}} {{id}} not checked ({{why}}). Fix the error in the file, then Gen4 Studio checks it.
skipped.other: {{title}}: not checked ({{why}}). Look under “{{unreadable}}” for what is missing, then check again.
